hunks.baseline: Watching the waves of aura wash across the horizon and surge toward him, the ground shuddering as if an earthquake had struck, Morgoth knew instinctively:
hunks.sol: The ground shook as if an earthquake had struck. Watching waves of aura wash across the horizon and surge toward him, Morgoth knew instinctively:

hunks.baseline: A low voice, its reverberation spreading deep and far.
hunks.sol: His low voice reverberated far and deep.

hunks.baseline: Language had power.
hunks.sol: Words had power.

hunks.baseline: And the Dragon’s words, imbued with immense magical power, had reached a realm no other race had ever trespassed.
hunks.sol: And the ancient Dragon’s words, imbued with immense magical power, reached a realm no other race had ever entered.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, countless eyes gleamed ominously from within the dark rift in space.
hunks.sol: Countless eyes gleamed ominously from within the dark rift.

hunks.baseline: Large and small shadows plummeted to the ground with bloodthirsty roars.
hunks.sol: Shadows large and small plummeted to the ground with roars full of killing intent.

hunks.baseline: With a single Warp spell, Morgoth had gathered the remaining forces occupying cities across the region. His voice turned cold as he gave the order.
hunks.sol: With a single Warp spell, Morgoth had gathered his remaining forces from the cities they occupied across the region. He gave the order in a cold voice.

hunks.baseline: Monsters charged at humans, humans charged at monsters, and soon light and darkness blurred together.
hunks.sol: Monsters charged at humans, humans charged at monsters, and light and darkness blurred together.

hunks.baseline: The shriek of keen steel and the sickening sound of flesh being torn apart swallowed the shouts. The Black Dragon’s eyes watched it all without a flicker as he gazed upon the blood mist hanging thick over the battlefield.
hunks.sol: The shriek of steel and the sickening sound of torn flesh swallowed the battle cries. Blood mist hung thick across the battlefield, and the Black Dragon watched it all without a flicker in his eyes.

hunks.baseline: Morgoth had already regained his composure. His mind was colder than ever.
hunks.sol: Morgoth had regained his composure. His mind was colder than ever.

hunks.baseline: Even if his elite monster legion, the force that had guarded his stronghold, had suffered heavy losses, he still had the reinforcements he’d just summoned. That alone was enough.
hunks.sol: His elite monster legion, the force that had guarded his stronghold, had suffered heavy losses. But he still had the reinforcements he’d just summoned, and they were enough.

hunks.baseline: The fate of the world would be decided in this great battle, and the victor would be determined not by mere numbers, but by whether one human lived or died.
hunks.sol: The fate of the world hung on this battle. Its outcome would be decided not by mere numbers, but by whether one human lived or died.

hunks.baseline: A blue-black flame advancing through the thousand Dragon-tooth soldiers surrounding him on every side like a dense forest.
hunks.sol: A blue-black flame slowly cutting through the thousand Dragon-tooth soldiers surrounding him like a dense forest.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, the short vow that small, insignificant human had spoken earlier echoed in Morgoth’s ears—and chilled a corner of his heart.
hunks.sol: And the short vow that small, insignificant human had made earlier echoed in Morgoth’s ears—the vow that had chilled him to the core.

hunks.baseline: With the Demon King Asmodeus gone, Morgoth alone was the true ruler destined to reign over every world—and that was exactly what he would become.
hunks.sol: With the Demon King Asmodeus gone, Morgoth alone was the true ruler of every world. He would make it so.

hunks.baseline: *Fwoosh—KABOOM!*
hunks.sol: *Fwoosh!*

hunks.baseline: A dozen or so spears of flame appeared out of nowhere in the air, poised to fall on Jin Taekyung.
hunks.sol: A dozen or so spears of flame appeared out of nowhere, about to rain down on Jin Taekyung.

hunks.baseline: A desperate shout rang out from somewhere. A massive icicle shot through space and blocked the flames.
hunks.sol: A desperate shout rang out from somewhere. A massive spike of ice tore through space and intercepted the flames.

hunks.baseline: The deflected flames slammed into the ground, harmless to their intended target. A dense cloud of steam rose, spreading across a radius of roughly a hundred meters and blocking the view in every direction.
hunks.sol: The deflected flames struck the empty ground. Steam billowed up, thick enough to obscure everything within a hundred-meter radius.

hunks.baseline: But the Black Dragon’s gleaming eyes saw clearly through it all.
hunks.sol: But the Black Dragon’s eyes saw clearly through it.

hunks.baseline: A group of people, their bodies covered in blood and dust, yet their eyes shining fiercely.
hunks.sol: A group of people covered head to toe in blood and dust, their eyes still blazing.

hunks.baseline: The towering Grand Mage caught his breath, then shouted like a roar.
hunks.sol: The towering Grand Mage caught his breath, then roared.

hunks.baseline: With a sky-piercing battle cry, thousands of the suicide squad—the first to arrive at this dreadful battlefield—charged toward the Dragon-tooth soldiers.
hunks.sol: With a battle cry that seemed to pierce the sky, the thousands-strong suicide squad—the first to reach this dreadful battlefield—charged toward the Dragon-tooth soldiers.

hunks.baseline: They were charging toward their Alliance Leader, their one and only hope.
hunks.sol: They charged toward their Alliance Leader, their one and only hope.

hunks.baseline: And through the chaos, a long-awaited voice reached my ears.
hunks.sol: And through the chaos, a voice I’d been waiting for reached my ears.

hunks.baseline: Magic Johnson. It was him.
hunks.sol: Magic Johnson. There he was.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, the blades of wind that rushed in passed close by the two Dragon-tooth soldiers charging at my flank.
hunks.sol: Blades of wind swept past the two Dragon-tooth soldiers charging at my flank.

hunks.baseline: If he’d aimed anywhere but their necks, even the Grand Mage’s Magic wouldn’t have been enough to kill them in one blow. But Magic Johnson had fought them before, in the Middle East. He knew their weakness exactly.
hunks.sol: If he’d aimed anywhere but their necks, even the Grand Mage’s Magic wouldn’t have killed them in one blow. But Magic Johnson had fought them before, in the Middle East. He knew their weakness.

hunks.baseline: And he knew this wasn’t the time for a long, friendly greeting.
hunks.sol: He also knew this wasn’t the time for a long, friendly greeting.

hunks.baseline: I tossed a dagger I’d just summoned from my Inventory to the man who’d greeted me with a single syllable.
hunks.sol: To the man who’d greeted me with a single syllable, I sent a dagger I’d just summoned from my Inventory.

hunks.baseline: More precisely, I threw it at the Dragon-tooth soldier lunging over his shoulder.
hunks.sol: More precisely, I threw it at the Dragon-tooth soldier lunging at him from behind.

hunks.baseline: A dagger thrown with all a normal Murim martial artist’s strength should properly be called a hidden weapon. But my Strength had long since surpassed that of most large monsters.
hunks.sol: A dagger thrown with all a normal Murim martial artist’s strength would rightly be called a hidden weapon. But my Strength had long since surpassed that of most large monsters.

hunks.baseline: The dagger shot forward like a flash and shattered not only the helmet made of some unknown metal, but the head beneath it, too. Drenched in the enemy’s brain matter, Magic Johnson muttered another curse.
hunks.sol: The dagger flashed forward and shattered the helmet made of some unknown metal—and the head beneath it. Drenched in the enemy’s brain matter, Magic Johnson muttered another curse.

hunks.baseline: “This is a special kind of hell.”
hunks.sol: “This is hell.”

hunks.baseline: That was true.
hunks.sol: Of course they had.

hunks.baseline: They knew their lives would be in danger, and still they’d answered my call without hesitation.
hunks.sol: They’d known their lives would be in danger, yet they’d answered my call willingly.

hunks.baseline: There were only twenty S-rank Hunters left in the entire world—or rather, now only a dozen or so—and they’d chosen only the very best before racing here from all over the globe.
hunks.sol: There had been only twenty S-rank Hunters in the entire world. Now there were barely a dozen left. They’d selected only the very best to bring with them and raced here from all over the globe.

hunks.baseline: But the tide of this great war, with the fate of all humanity at stake, was still as dark and heavy as the storm clouds overhead.
hunks.sol: But the tide of this Great War, with everything humanity had at stake, was still as dark and damp as the clouds overhead.

hunks.baseline: “Damn it, what the hell are those things? There are this many of them?”
hunks.sol: “Damn it, what the hell? There are this many of those awful things?”

hunks.baseline: Their magical power surpassed that of even the strongest Death Knights, classified at the top of A-rank. Their bodies were horrifyingly tough, and they were stubbornly hard to kill.
hunks.sol: They had more magical power than even the strongest Death Knights, which ranked at the top of A-rank. Their bodies were horribly tough, and they were stubbornly hard to kill.

hunks.baseline: Calling each one as formidable as a named monster would be no exaggeration.
hunks.sol: Each one was as troublesome as a named monster. That was no exaggeration.

hunks.baseline: But even Magic Johnson, who knew all this well, still didn’t know one thing.
hunks.sol: But even Magic Johnson, who knew all this well, didn’t know one thing yet.

hunks.baseline: The Dragon-tooth soldiers weren’t the only obstacle we’d have to overcome to reach Morgoth.
hunks.sol: The Dragon-tooth soldiers weren’t the only obstacle we had to overcome to reach Morgoth.

hunks.baseline: Something shot toward us at the speed of light.
hunks.sol: Something shot toward us like a beam of light.

hunks.baseline: It came without giving me a moment to breathe. I blocked it with the side of my spear blade, held at an angle.
hunks.sol: With no time to catch my breath, I angled my spear blade and caught it on the flat.

hunks.baseline: Even with no small amount of internal energy poured into it, the shaft of my spear trembled.
hunks.sol: I’d poured plenty of internal energy into the spear, but its shaft still trembled.

hunks.baseline: Magic Johnson let out a low groan at the familiar face that appeared beyond it.
hunks.sol: Magic Johnson let out a low groan at the familiar face beyond it.

hunks.baseline: The moment he recognized his old comrade, someone he’d known for decades, ever since the Great Cataclysm began, Magic Johnson was shaken more than ever. And when their number finally reached seven, his whole body trembled.
hunks.sol: He’d known that old comrade for decades, since the beginning of the Great Cataclysm. Seeing him shook Magic Johnson more than anything had yet. And when the number of familiar faces reached seven, his whole body trembled.

hunks.baseline: “That’s what Morgoth calls them. His Guardians. They’re supposed to protect him.”
hunks.sol: “That’s what Morgoth calls them. His Guardians. They protect him.”

hunks.baseline: Even I, a complete outsider to Magic, could clearly sense the magical power controlling them. There was no need to ask what the Grand Mage could feel.
hunks.sol: Even I, who knew nothing about Magic, could clearly sense the magical power controlling them. The Grand Mage would have felt it all the more.

hunks.baseline: The voice, tangled with too many emotions, mingled with the wind and gradually quieted.
hunks.sol: His voice carried them all. Then it gradually quieted, leaving only one.

hunks.baseline: Leaving only one behind.
“Near the end of the Great Cataclysm, we talked about it when we were all together.”
hunks.sol: “Near the end of the Great Cataclysm, when we were all together, we talked about what we’d do.”

hunks.baseline: The fists he kept throwing carried more than just the mysterious power known as aura.
hunks.sol: The fists he kept throwing carried more than the mysterious power called aura.

hunks.baseline: Memories from the past.
hunks.sol: They carried memories.

hunks.baseline: The memories of those days, so painful they could have killed him, yet filled with hope that things would soon get better, poured forth with his aura.
hunks.sol: Memories of days so painful he’d thought they might kill him, yet filled with hope that things would soon get better. They poured out with his aura.

hunks.baseline: They burst outward in every direction. They scattered.
Shattered weapons. The armor and bodies of the Dragon-tooth soldiers.
hunks.sol: Shattered weapons flew in every direction, along with pieces of the Dragon-tooth soldiers’ armor and bodies.

hunks.baseline: And the tears of an old man who had lost his longtime friends.
hunks.sol: And the tears of an old soldier who had lost his longtime friends.

hunks.baseline: The roar, filled with grief and anger, contained everything.
hunks.sol: His roar held all his grief and anger.

hunks.baseline: Why hadn’t they been allowed to keep even that simple promise to live happily for a long time? Why did they have to suffer this humiliation even after death?
hunks.sol: Why couldn’t they keep even that simple promise to live happily for a long time? Why did they have to suffer this humiliation even after death?

hunks.baseline: But no voice answered his questions.
hunks.sol: But no voice answered him.

hunks.baseline: The only answer was the Black Dragon’s Magic once again filling the sky, and the footsteps of his old comrades as they advanced.
hunks.sol: All that came in reply was the Black Dragon’s Magic filling the sky once more—and the footsteps of his old comrades advancing beneath it.

hunks.baseline: Dozens of bolts plunged down like divine punishment, while the seven Guardians and countless Dragon-tooth soldiers charged forward, their pitch-black magical power streaming behind them like cloaks.
hunks.sol: Dozens of bolts plunged down like divine punishment. The seven Guardians and countless Dragon-tooth soldiers charged forward, pitch-black magical power streaming behind them like cloaks.

hunks.baseline: An overpowering force that seemed impossible to stop.
hunks.sol: They came with a force that seemed impossible to stop.

hunks.baseline: But that wasn’t what happened.
hunks.sol: But they didn’t break through.

hunks.baseline: And dozens of voices filled it.
hunks.sol: Dozens of voices joined in it.

hunks.baseline: At the front stood Magic Johnson. Behind him were the world’s greatest mages, following the only Grand Mage humanity had.
hunks.sol: Magic Johnson stood at their head. Behind him were the world’s greatest mages, following humanity’s only Grand Mage.

hunks.baseline: A ceiling of rock suddenly appeared over our allies’ heads. When it met the lightning, a tremendous explosion shook the battlefield.
hunks.sol: A ceiling of rock appeared over our allies’ heads. It met the lightning with a tremendous explosion.

hunks.baseline: No—cancellation.
hunks.sol: No—the two spells canceled each other out.

hunks.baseline: As immense magical power shook space again, I shot straight forward, leaving the falling rocks behind me.
hunks.sol: As immense magical power began shaking space again, I shot straight forward, leaving the falling rocks behind me.

hunks.baseline: But there was one difference.
hunks.sol: But one thing was different.

hunks.baseline: Another group of familiar faces finally broke through the chaotic battlefield.
hunks.sol: More familiar faces finally broke through the chaos.

hunks.baseline: The brown-haired foreigner at the front gave me a slight nod.
hunks.sol: The brown-haired foreigner at the front tipped his head toward me.

hunks.baseline: “Good. Though even if I were, I wasn’t planning to apologize.”
hunks.sol: “Good. Though I wouldn’t have apologized if I were.”

hunks.baseline: That irritating way of speaking, still exactly as I remembered it.
hunks.sol: That irritating way of speaking was exactly as I remembered it.

hunks.baseline: Prince Felix had joined us with four S-rank Hunters. He added, “Go. Now. We’ll handle things here.”
hunks.sol: Prince Felix had arrived with four S-rank Hunters. He added, “Go. Quickly. We’ll handle things here.”

hunks.baseline: I just suppressed the hot feeling rising deep in my chest and pushed forward with all my might.
hunks.sol: I held back the heat rising deep in my chest and pushed forward with all my might.

hunks.baseline: Leaving the seven S-rank Hunters behind as they clashed with their old comrades.
hunks.sol: Behind me, seven S-rank Hunters clashed with their old comrades.

hunks.baseline: I cut them down, one after another.
hunks.sol: I cut one down, then another.

hunks.baseline: Kept going, without stopping.
hunks.sol: Kept going. Didn’t stop.

hunks.baseline: And then—
hunks.sol: Toward the monster who was the beginning and end of it all.

hunks.baseline: Toward the monster who was the beginning and end of it all.

hunks.baseline: In the Black Dragon’s vast, gleaming eyes, a human leaping upward, stomping on thin air, was reflected.
hunks.sol: In the Black Dragon’s vast, gleaming eyes, a human rose into the air, treading on empty space.
